issue_request: FHIR-49996 was an Applied R6 FHIR-core Device change request from OO. It reported that the Device Boundaries and Relationships entries for DeviceRequest/DeviceDispense, SupplyRequest/SupplyDelivery, and DeviceUsage lacked descriptions. The final Not Persuasive with Modification resolution narrowed the remaining correction to removing the extra slash after DeviceRequest.
initial_application: The descriptive text appears to have been initially applied in broader Device text update commit 3cf635fa2b606d038462a683a53338e39b3f30e3, which replaced bare paired links with individual descriptions but left an extra slash after DeviceRequest. The explicit FHIR-49996 commit 649c4f3bdb9606e5d26e123edaa606440e87a0be then removed that slash.
additional_context: The Device page source is in build scope through source/fhir.ini's active Device entry. Later history moved DeviceDispense, SupplyRequest, SupplyDelivery, and DeviceUsage links to the OO incubator after those resources left the core build, while preserving the descriptions requested by this issue. OO Confluence minutes record the same Not Persuasive with Modification disposition and 7-0-0 vote.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/device/device-introduction.xml Boundaries and Relationships section includes descriptions for DeviceRequest, DeviceDispense, SupplyRequest, SupplyDelivery, and DeviceUsage; the DeviceRequest slash is absent; and later link updates are consistent with current build scope.
